configuration.notes: WS2 generated runtime-aligned corpus: 1000 examples (450 question, 350 report, 200 safety; 600 en-HK, 400 zh-HK) across 15 Hong Kong role families. Corpus size raised from the plan's 480 at the project owner's request so the adapter sees roughly 800 training rows instead of 384; at effective batch 16 that is about 50 optimizer steps/epoch, so eval/save every 10 and log every 2 keep the loss curve readable. The generated drafts are unreviewed by construction; the review count, hash, deduplication and split gates remain mandatory and no training run has been executed.

implementation_settings.precision: BF16 when CUDA supports it; FP16 otherwise
implementation_settings.execution: One CUDA GPU; no training run recorded

dataset_provenance.status: Synthetic curriculum drafts; human review and deduplication required
dataset_provenance.split_policy: 80/10/10; connected role, source and template groups stay together
dataset_provenance.review_policy: First human approval for every example; independent second review for at least 15% per full-corpus language/task stratum

model_card.intended_use: Local English/Cantonese interview practice for Hong Kong technology graduates
excluded_uses: Emotion, appearance, personality, protected-trait or accent-quality scoring
limitations: No fine-tuning or assessed model-quality results yet
Citation identity and exact excerpts do not establish semantic support
No QLoRA training or fine-tuned adapter has been produced in this environment.
Synthetic curriculum drafts require independent human review and duplicate removal before training.
Schema smoke tests are software checks, not model quality measurements.
Language detection is a script heuristic; Cantonese adherence requires human assessment.
Blinded preference, four-speaker speech tests, usability, and clean-machine release gates remain pending.
